CREATE VIEW high_fidelity_meshes AS
SELECT 
    sm.facetregistry AS mesh_id,
    sm.zoneref AS site_reference,
    e.equipform AS equipment,
    sm.facetverts AS facet_vertex_count,
    sm.facetfaces AS facet_face_count,
    sm.facetresmm AS resolution_mm,
    sm.geomdeltamm AS accuracy_mm,
    ROUND(CAST((sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * sm.facetresmm * sm.facetresmm)) * 1000 AS numeric), 4) AS mesh_complexity_ratio
FROM scanmesh sm
JOIN equipment e ON sm.equipref = e.equipregistry
WHERE 
    (sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * sm.facetresmm * sm.facetresmm)) * 1000 > 5.0
    AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0
    AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5;
